title: NSW minimum standards for a rental
description: The seven minimum standards a NSW rental must meet to be fit to live in, plus related safety checks. Summarised from NSW Fair Trading pages on section 52 of the Residential Tenancies Act 2010.

sources.title: Getting repairs done on a rental property
Window, deck, and balcony safety in a rental property

items.title: Adequate natural or artificial lighting in each room except storage rooms and garages
Electricity or gas supplied, with enough sockets for lighting, heating and appliances
Hot and cold water for drinking, washing and cleaning
Bathroom and toilet facilities that allow privacy
Reasonably clean when the tenant moves in
No outstanding urgent repairs, such as gas leaks, electrical faults, broken toilets or no hot water
Window safety devices fitted if the building is strata
